title: D-Wave Quantum annual net loss
definition: GAAP net loss reported by D-Wave Quantum Inc. (expressed as a positive magnitude in million USD).

sources.title: Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1: D-Wave Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2025 Results

points.evidence: Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Highlights: 'Net loss for fiscal 2024 was $143.9 million' (GAAP basis).
Fiscal Year 2025 Financial Highlights: 'Net loss for fiscal 2025 was $355.1 million' (GAAP basis, including $270.5 million non-cash warrant charges).
